This '''commander''' was a [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|clone SCUBA trooper]] that accompanied [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to investigate reports by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] seen near an abandoned station.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />

==History==
While investigating the area to find out what was killing all the surrounding wildlife, underwater motion sensors were triggered alerting the battle droids to the intrusion. The commander and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]] [[Skirmish on Rodia|helped eliminate]] the droid presence while Kit Fisto battled with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], who had reprogrammed the droids to protect him while he was in hiding. The commander survived the engagement, though two of his men were killed by blaster fire from the droids.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />

==Armor and equipment==
This clone commander had armor decorated in a Cyan color scheme with many stripes and a [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] helmet similar to that of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone marshal commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. During the mission he utilized a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]]. He didn't wear a SCUBA pack unlike most of his squad.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters" />
